representative_quotes: Goede en aardige instructeur, Alles werd rustig stap voor stap behandeld.
Kon ook aangeven wat ik nog lastig vond (daar werd dan meer aandacht aan besteed).

review_summary: Across 9 five-star Google reviews for this tiny one-instructor school, students consistently praise Harri as a calm, patient, friendly instructor who explains everything step by step, pays extra attention to personal weak points, stays composed when learners make mistakes, and builds their confidence; a couple also note easy scheduling and smooth lessons. The reviews are uniformly glowing but short and homogeneous, from a single platform, with no negative feedback and no sign of English/expat lessons.
